_comment: Graph view queries (studio/src/components/GraphView.tsx). tests/studio_graph_queries_test.rs runs them against the engine. Each query is appended to `prefixes`; `$TERM` in instanceSearch is replaced with the escaped search text.
prefixes:
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
classes: SELECT DISTINCT ?c ?label WHERE { { ?c a owl:Class } UNION { ?c a rdfs:Class } FILTER(isIRI(?c)) OPTIONAL { ?c rdfs:label ?label } }
sub: SELECT DISTINCT ?s ?o WHERE { ?s rdfs:subClassOf ?o . { ?s a owl:Class } UNION { ?s a rdfs:Class } FILTER(isIRI(?s) && isIRI(?o) && ?s != ?o) }
props: SELECT DISTINCT ?p ?t ?label ?code WHERE { { VALUES ?t { owl:ObjectProperty owl:DatatypeProperty } ?p a ?t } UNION { ?p a rdf:Property ; rdfs:domain ?d ; rdfs:range ?r . FILTER(isIRI(?d) && isIRI(?r)) FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?p a owl:ObjectProperty } FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?p a owl:DatatypeProperty } BIND(rdf:Property AS ?t) } FILTER(isIRI(?p)) OPTIONAL { ?p rdfs:label ?label } OPTIONAL { ?p skos:notation ?code } }
domRange: SELECT ?p ?k ?c WHERE { { ?p rdfs:domain ?c . BIND("d" AS ?k) } UNION { ?p rdfs:range ?c . BIND("r" AS ?k) } UNION { ?p rdfs:domain ?u . ?u owl:unionOf ?l . ?l rdf:rest*/rdf:first ?c . BIND("d" AS ?k) } UNION { ?p rdfs:range ?u . ?u owl:unionOf ?l . ?l rdf:rest*/rdf:first ?c . BIND("r" AS ?k) } FILTER(isIRI(?c)) }
instanceSearch: SELECT DISTINCT ?n ?label WHERE { ?n a ?t . { ?t a owl:Class } UNION { ?t a rdfs:Class } OPTIONAL { ?n rdfs:label ?label } FILTER(isIRI(?n) && (CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?n)), LCASE("$TERM")) || CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?label)), LCASE("$TERM")))) } LIMIT 40
